Analysis complete. Preparing the final report.

Eleven persistent entity types were identified across the store directory, migration scripts, and generated protobufs. The analysis scope is limited to `store/`, `store/db/`, `store/migration/`, `proto/store/`, and `proto/gen/store/`. Any external references originate from packages outside these paths.

User and Memo each appear in 7 external packages. User leads on file count with roughly 30–41 references versus Memo’s 22–31. Attachment ranks third with 5 packages.

## Data layer entity types

The data layer is the `store` package (`/bench/repo/store/`) plus its protobuf companions (`/bench/repo/proto/store/`, `/bench/repo/proto/gen/store/`). It defines **11 persistent entity structs** (one per DB table in `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql`):

| Entity | Defining file |
|---|---|
| `User` | `/bench/repo/store/user.go` |
| `UserSetting` | `/bench/repo/store/user_setting.go` |
| `Memo` | `/bench/repo/store/memo.go` |
| `MemoRelation` | `/bench/repo/store/memo_relation.go` |
| `Attachment` | `/bench/repo/store/attachment.go` |
| `IdentityProvider` | `/bench/repo/store/idp.go` |
| `Inbox` | `/bench/repo/store/inbox.go` |
| `Reaction` | `/bench/repo/store/reaction.go` |
| `MemoShare` | `/bench/repo/store/memo_share.go` |
| `UserIdentity` | `/bench/repo/store/user_identity.go` |
| `InstanceSetting` | `/bench/repo/store/instance_setting.go` |

References were counted as uses of `store.<Entity>`, `store.Find<Entity>`, `store.Update<Entity>`, or `store.Delete<Entity>` in Go files **outside** the paths above. No `internal/` packages reference these types.

## Top two by external package reach

### 1. `User` — ~7 external packages (~41 files)

**Defined at:** `/bench/repo/store/user.go:29` (`type User struct`)

**External packages (7):**

| Package | Evidence file |
|---|---|
| `server/auth` | `server/auth/authenticator.go` — `(*store.User, string, error)` return from auth |
| `server/notification` | `server/notification/email.go` — `GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{...})` |
| `server/router/api/v1` | `server/router/api/v1/user_service.go` — `&store.FindUser{}` |
| `server/router/api/v1/test` | `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go` — `CreateHostUser(...) (*store.User, error)` |
| `server/router/fileserver` | `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go` — `getCurrentUser(...) (*store.User, error)` |
| `server/router/frontend` | `server/router/frontend/frontend_test.go` — `CreateUser(ctx, &store.User{...})` |
| `server/router/rss` | `server/router/rss/rss.go` — `GetUser(ctx, &store.FindUser{...})` |

Unique to `User` among the leaders: **`server/auth`**.

---

### 2. `Memo` — ~7 external packages (~31 files)

**Defined at:** `/bench/repo/store/memo.go:35` (`type Memo struct`)

**External packages (7):**

| Package | Evidence file |
|---|---|
| `server/notification` | `server/notification/email.go` — `map[int32]*store.Memo` in email builder |
| `server/router/api/v1` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` — `checkMemoReadAccess(..., memo *store.Memo)` |
| `server/router/api/v1/test` | `server/router/api/v1/test/memo_service_test.go` — `CreateMemo(ctx, &store.Memo{...})` |
| `server/router/fileserver` | `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go` — `GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{...})` |
| `server/router/frontend` | `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` — `ListMemos(..., &store.FindMemo{...})` |
| `server/router/rss` | `server/router/rss/rss.go` — `store.FindMemo{...}` |
| `server/runner/memopayload` | `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` — `ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{...})` |

Unique to `Memo` among the leaders: **`server/runner/memopayload`**.

---

## Notes

- **`User` and `Memo` tie at 7 distinct external packages**; `User` leads on file-level references (~41 vs ~31).
- **#3 is `Attachment`** at ~5 packages (`server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/s3presign`).
- Several entities (`InstanceSetting`, `IdentityProvider`, `UserSetting`) are consumed outside the data layer mainly via **`storepb.*` protobuf types** and `Store` methods rather than their raw `store.*` structs, which is why `store.InstanceSetting` shows 0 direct external struct references despite heavy runtime use.
